title: The Pack Den
text: A den under the roots of a great tree, and in it a litter of pups with eyes like coals, tumbling over each other, growling in small voices. The bones around the den are fresh. The mother is out hunting. Not far out.

options.label: The Leader takes a pup to raise, before the mother comes home.

outcomes.text: It bites, then settles, then follows. It will be a great hound, or something else.
The mother was not far out.

options.label: Leave the pups and go quietly. No mother forgives a stolen child.

outcomes.text: The mother passes you on the path an hour later, bloody to the shoulder, and only looks.

options.label: Wait by the den for the mother, and kill her when she comes home.
